senses.gloss: f. (שוי, cmp. אַשְׁיְתָא a. אַשְׁוָתָא) skein, reel, clue, esp. staff around which the wool is put, spool.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:1">Kel. XXI, 1</cite> the wool which is on the distaff <he>ובא׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בא׳</he> corr. acc.) or on the spool.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 6</cite> <he>צמר שעל גבי האַשְׁוָוה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>אשה</he>, cler. err.).
